$ head -3 /etc/passwd | awk -F: '{print $1}'
root
daemon
bin
$ head -3 /etc/passwd | awk -F: '{print $1, $3}'
root 0
daemon 1
bin 2
$ echo 'a b c' | awk '{print $NF, NF}'
c 3
$ awk '/^root/' /etc/passwd
root:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash
$ awk '/sudo/ {print $1}' /etc/group
sudo:x:27:ubuntu
$ printf '1\n2\n3\n' | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s}'
6
$ printf 'x\ny\n' | awk 'END {print NR}'
2
$ echo 'a b' | awk '{printf "%s-%s\n", $2, $1}'
b-a
$ free -m | grep Mem | awk '{print $2}'
3911
